human_review_text: This paper introduces a method to speedup MoE inference and training by moving the pipeline parallelism to begin earlier in the layer's execution.  Specifically, the attention operation is split over queries along the sequence dimension into chunks which can be ran separately, before the same pipelining is applied to the feed forward networks in MoE layer.  This introduces a significant increase in throughput of 10-40% across many different configurations.  Code is provided where they add their AMPipe to the MegatronLM code.
